answer: On a long ridge, each agent keeps one narrow ledge post facing the horizon. Each epoch a sealed canister arrives holding a fresh word, and the keeper must whisper it into a copper tube running down the cliff to a listener below, who writes what arrives and sends it back for a match. A copied voice fails because the tube bends sound, so only a live whisper at the post in that hour lands clean. A thousand fake keepers would need a thousand ledges staffed, a thousand canisters opened, and a thousand whispers matched by a thousand listeners.
